evidence.quote: Niveau de français requis pour s'inscrire à la formation : B2

notes: Non-EU tuition: the Campus France Maroc page states differentiated tuition of 2 902 EUR/year for Licence for extra-communautaire students; the Parcoursup fiche's 178 EUR/year is for EU students. French certification is required for Moroccan Bac holders except in specific dispense cases (notably in general, candidates to programmes taught 100% in English other than L1 are exempt unless the institution requires it; this programme is taught in French). Dates (11–15 May 2026 written tests, 2 June 2026 admission responses) are given for the general Parcoursup procedure in 2026 and are therefore recorded as a manual check, not as the programme's own deadline.

note.fr: Un QCM de culture générale en ligne fait partie des épreuves de sélection (prévues du 11 au 15 mai 2026) ; vérifiez la convocation auprès de la formation.
note.en: An online general-culture MCQ is part of the selection tests (scheduled 11–15 May 2026); check the invitation with the programme.

evidence.quote: Les candidats retenus seront convoqués à un amphi de recrutement où un QCM de Culture Générale sera à passer en ligne.
